## Parent

Part of https://github.com/trajectonomics/factory/issues/2

## What to build

Read issues, blocking edges, parents and the board from GitHub, and write Claims, labels, Status and comments. A dry-run mode writes nothing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reads match recorded GitHub fixtures
- [ ] Dry-run prints the intended writes and performs none
- [ ] Every comment the Factory posts opens with the AI disclaimer and is idempotent on re-run
